name: Boglurker
bio: Crawled out of the marsh for the noise and stayed for the shooting. Smells exactly as you fear.
notes: Its model replaced 2026-11-06 (Drive intake of 2026-11-06, the owner: "The boglurker can be replaced by the alligator") by "A humanoid crocodile wearing a heavy" (as Meshy names the download): a broad crocodile in iron pauldrons, bracers and greaves with a long tail; rigged and animated on Meshy (Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; finger chains without an index finger, so the fingers are re-fitted by hands.mjs; the tail's and the snout's extra joints ride the hips and the head; its two clips are not used). Same name, look ID and size (large); the Boglurker NPC role keeps the look. The model it replaced ("Boglurker the toad", an unrigged FBX rigged here from landmarks) is no longer shipped.
